description: Search 7 500+ Medicare-certified dialysis (ESRD — End-Stage Renal Disease) facilities across the US with CMS 5-star quality ratings. Filter by state, city, ZIP code, facility name, and non-profit status. Returns CMS Certification Number (CCN), facility name, address, phone, profit/non-profit status, chain ownership flag, and 5-star quality rating from CMS ESRD Quality Incentive Program (QIP). Dialysis is required 3× per week for ESRD patients — finding a conveniently located, high-quality facility is critical for quality of life. Covers all DaVita, Fresenius, US Renal Care, and independent clinic locations. No auth — US Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services public domain, unlimited free.

city.description: City or town name to filter dialysis facilities (partial match). Example: "Atlanta", "Denver".

limit.description: Maximum number of dialysis facilities to return (1–100, default 20).

name.description: Partial facility name to search (case-insensitive substring match). Example: "DaVita", "Fresenius", "Dialysis Center".

nonprofit_only.description: When true, filter to only non-profit dialysis facilities. Non-profit facilities may have different care incentives vs. for-profit chains.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

state.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation to filter dialysis facilities (e.g. CA, FL, TX).

zip_code.description: 5-digit US ZIP code to filter dialysis facilities.

name: cms.dialysis.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: CMS — US Dialysis Facility Search
